REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS.EFFECTIVE_SPECIFICATION: Only ISSUE32 defines the currently approved baseline contract. Previous specifications are available in immutable Git history and Issue #25 approval discussions; they are not part of these active XML artifacts. No /v1, /v2, Bearer, legacy-client support or data migration.
REQUIREMENTS_ANALYSIS.DRAFT_TARGET_DECISION: Project Owner's Issue #4 decision proposes replacing Centrifuge with ntfy as the chat realtime transport, not retaining Centrifuge as an additional target channel. Until Human Approval, ISSUE32 remains the approved baseline. Backend Issue #36 is unchanged and contains a conflicting additive-channel statement.

ISSUE32_REQUIREMENTS_REVISION.SCOPE: Target-only correction. Historical approved clauses and approval records remain as evidence of prior decisions; incompatible historical API paths are not the target contract. No production implementation authorized.
ISSUE32_REQUIREMENTS_REVISION.GOAL: One unified direct/group conversation service exposed solely through the unversioned /conversations HTTP resource tree, authenticated exclusively with BFE Drive Internal Auth validated DPoP-bound sessions.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: All target conversation HTTP operations use /conversations and its unversioned descendants. /v1 and /v2 are not target HTTP APIs. Existing /v2 domain behavior is the implementation migration baseline, not a second API.

Every protected target HTTP request requires DPoP proof bound to the validated BFE Drive session through existing Internal Auth; plain Bearer is not an accepted authentication scheme. WebSocket authentication and subscriptions preserve required independent membership verification and revocation rules.
Direct and group conversations share one conversation identity, message stream, authorization model and history semantics, retaining type-specific membership and ownership rules.

Retain all functional direct/group conversation behavior, permissions, message/document handling and idempotency from the working /v2 implementation. No legacy-client support, production-data inventory or migration is in scope; destructive removal of populated legacy tables is not authorized.

A 1:1 conversation is created by authenticated account UUID and distinct peer UUID. Self-direct is rejected. Creation for the same unordered pair is unique and concurrency-safe. Personal hide affects only caller visibility, never peer access, messages or direct identity.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for direct without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Authenticated user creates named group with owner and selected account UUIDs. Maximum 100 members including owner. Creator is owner. Group supports rename, invited-member changes, role management and departure. A member may leave. The owner must transfer ownership to another current group member before leaving; if there is no other current member, the last owner cannot leave. Exactly one owner must remain after each successful operation.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for group without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Owner may manage group and appoint or dismiss admins, while preserving exactly one owner; admin can only perform explicitly allowed membership or rename operations, cannot remove owner/other admin, appoint admins or transfer ownership; member cannot administer group. BFE Drive ADMIN status does not grant Chat membership or management.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for roles without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Every membership addition/removal creates an auditable bounded visibility interval. Read and message delivery are permitted only for messages within caller intervals. On rejoin, messages from the gap stay hidden. Removal immediately blocks subsequent protected operations and active WebSocket subscriptions. Membership mutations and send/delivery authorization have a defined atomic ordering.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for membership without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Each conversation has one stable monotonic conversation-scoped message order and cursor pagination, default 50 and max 100 messages per page. Every history query filters by authenticated viewer membership intervals. The same visibility rule applies to reconnect and historical catch-up.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for history without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Only authenticated current members send messages; sender identity is never supplied by a trusted client field. Text maximum 16384 UTF-8 bytes, request JSON maximum 65536 bytes. Idempotency key replay returns original result for identical content and 409 Conflict for different content; concurrency cannot create duplicates.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for message without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Optional message context holds document ID and title; preserve both in message history and events. Chat neither copies document content nor grants any BFE Drive document rights. Document access is independently checked by BFE Drive.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for document without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Centrifuge publishes persisted messages only to currently authorized members. Revalidate authorized subscriptions and revocation even for established sockets. Reconnect recovers missed messages through persisted conversation history; multi-device membership and read states remain coherent.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for realtime without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Read marker is monotonically increasing per account and conversation and shared across devices. Unread counts include only authorized messages sent by other users. One member cannot advance another member read marker.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for read without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: All Chat-specific conversation state and ACLs are within bfe_chat. BFE Drive sessions are validated through existing Internal Auth UDS; account UUID alone grants no Chat authorization. Reject out-of-scope access without leaking data.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for isolation without changes to legacy clients or production data.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Group names limited to 256 UTF-8 bytes; no more than 100 group members; JSON body max 65536 bytes; message text max 16384 UTF-8 bytes; history page max 100. Reject invalid input before changes or publications.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Verify authorized success, unauthorized rejection, concurrency or boundary behavior for limits without changes to legacy clients or production data.

DRAFT_REALTIME_REVISION.SCOPE: Requirements-only proposal to supersede REQ32-REALTIME's Centrifuge target. ISSUE32 approval provenance remains historical; this proposal is not effective until Human Approval. Technology.xml, DevelopmentPlan.xml and Contracts.xml remain unchanged.
DRAFT_REALTIME_REVISION.SUPERSEDES_PROPOSAL: Centrifuge is not the proposed target realtime transport; ntfy is proposed instead. Issue #36 currently says ntfy is additive and Centrifuge remains. This issue is not edited or closed.
DRAFT_REALTIME_REVISION.GOAL: Deliver chat realtime wake-up signals through ntfy while keeping HTTP APIs and PostgreSQL authoritative for messages, membership, history, roles and read state.

AAG_SCENARIOS.ACTOR: A current BFE session user who may access only conversations authorized by backend membership and visibility intervals.
Owns approval of release readiness, compatibility evidence and production boundaries; this draft does not grant deployment authority.

USE_CASE.title: Receive realtime signals and recover authoritative state
USE_CASE.ACTION: Subscribe to authorized realtime signals and refresh conversation state through the Chat HTTP API.
USE_CASE.GOAL: Observe current authorized messages and read state without treating ntfy as an authority or durable history.

USE_CASE.title: Verify target realtime release boundaries
USE_CASE.ACTION: Review actual client integration, compatibility evidence, rollout and rollback constraints.
USE_CASE.GOAL: Prevent unverified ntfy requirements from authorizing production changes.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: ntfy replaces Centrifuge as target realtime transport, not an additional channel or source of truth. Centrifuge remains only the current approved baseline until the draft is approved and dependent contracts are revised.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Target requirements do not retain Centrifuge as a parallel channel; HTTP/PostgreSQL remain authoritative for message/history/read-state fetches.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Backend determines recipients and topic mapping from authenticated identity, authoritative membership and bounded visibility intervals. Clients cannot choose recipient lists or arbitrary topics; topic names alone are not authorization. Exact ntfy ACL/auth mechanism is unresolved.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Negative tests prove unauthorized cross-account/conversation subscription and publish are denied; recipients are selected server-side.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Member removal, rejoin, visibility change, session revocation and account switch invalidate prior ntfy authorization. Active subscribers must stop receiving protected signals within an approved tested bound; immediate ntfy-side revocation is not assumed.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Already-connected subscriber receives no later protected event after the approved bound; rejoin does not reveal gap history; expired/revoked/cross-session capability fails closed.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: ntfy events are minimal wake-up signals. Clients reconcile via the authoritative unversioned HTTP API after connect/reconnect or suspected gaps. Event identity, cursors, dedupe and catch-up trigger remain to be specified; ntfy replay, ordering and durability are not presumed.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Duplicate, missing, reordered and delayed signals converge to backend-authoritative history/read state without duplicate messages or visibility beyond membership intervals.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Payloads contain only minimum approved opaque identifiers for backend refresh. No message text, document title/content, access tokens, DPoP proofs, private keys or protected metadata. Chat membership does not grant Drive document access.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Payload/log inspection finds no protected content or credentials; conversation membership cannot bypass Drive ACL checks.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Successful database commit remains a successful send if ntfy publication fails or times out. Retry/outbox/equivalent, dedupe and sanitized observability must be designed and approved; no mechanism is presumed.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Post-commit ntfy outage does not change committed send result; failure is observable without secrets and approved retry/dedupe behavior is testable.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Subscriptions are scoped to current BFE session and membership. Logout/account switch/revocation invalidates old subscriptions; events grant no authority to read messages, and each history request independently uses existing session-bound DPoP HTTP authorization.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: After account switch old subscriptions and state are cleared before new data appears; old-account history is not exposed under the new account.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Conversation membership, realtime topic membership and document access are separate permission domains. Only BFE Drive authorizes document content; Chat does not infer or proxy Drive ACLs.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: A user receiving a conversation signal but lacking Drive permission cannot fetch/open the document.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: This requirements revision does not change bfe-drive, bfe-drive-client production behavior, Drive sessions/ACLs or production infrastructure. Actual chat package integration, compatibility, rollout and rollback must be evidenced before implementation.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Reviewed release plan identifies deployed client versions/dependencies, compatibility, migration/coexistence if required, rollback triggers and release owner; no production changes occur in this phase.

REQUIREMENT.RULE: Web and Android must use a documented supported ntfy subscription transport/auth contract. Browser CORS/header/cookie restrictions and Android background/Doze/process-death limits are requirements evidence. No universal background delivery or ntfy-specific BFE DPoP support is assumed.
REQUIREMENT.ACCEPTANCE: Transport/auth evidence covers supported browsers and Android lifecycle states; limitations are documented before implementation.

DRAFT_REALTIME_REVISION.INVARIANT: ntfy signals never grant access or replace backend authorization/history.
Payloads and diagnostics never disclose protected content or credentials.
A subscription is valid only for its current authenticated session and authorized membership interval.
Chat membership or ntfy topic access never grants Drive document permissions.
Failure of the realtime transport cannot reverse or misreport an already committed message; retries must not create duplicate authoritative messages.
Requirements-only work does not change production repositories, data, permissions, configuration or infrastructure; rollout requires separate evidence and authorization.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: Account A attempts to subscribe to a topic or conversation authorized only for account B.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: Subscription or publish is denied without disclosing topic contents; a topic name is not authorization.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: A member is removed or rejoins while an old subscription is still connected.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: Protected delivery stops within the approved bound; the visibility gap remains hidden after rejoin.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: The user logs out or switches from account A to account B while realtime is active.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: The old subscription and account-scoped cache are cleared before account B data is shown; old-account history is not exposed.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: Realtime events are missing, duplicated, delayed or reordered, followed by reconnect.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: HTTP history/read-state reconciliation converges to backend-authoritative state without duplicate messages or visibility outside membership intervals.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: PostgreSQL commits a message, then ntfy publication times out or is unavailable.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: The send remains successful; failure is observable without secrets; the approved retry/dedupe contract does not create duplicate messages.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.refs: REQ36-RT-05 REQ36-RT-08 AC36-RT-05 AC36-RT-08 INV36-NTFY-PRIVACY INV36-NTFY-DRIVE-ACL
MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: A user receives a chat signal containing a document reference but has no Drive permission.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: The signal contains no protected content or credentials, and Drive denies document access independently of chat membership.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: A browser cannot use the chosen subscription auth mechanism, or Android is suspended, killed or force-stopped.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: No credentials are placed in URLs; no unsupported background-delivery guarantee is assumed; the client reconciles authoritative state when it can resume.

MENTAL_SCENARIO.INPUT: The draft is reviewed while deployed-client integration and rollback compatibility are still unknown.
MENTAL_SCENARIO.EXPECTED: Implementation and rollout remain blocked; no production repository, data, permission, configuration or infrastructure changes occur.
